drawer_persona.name: drawer_persona
drawer_persona.description: Read the current SOUL.md from this bot's installed Hermes profile. Use when asked to show your persona, identity instructions or persona file. Returns its exact text and profile, separately from conversation memory. Read-only; takes no paths or arguments and cannot modify files.

drawer_orders.name: drawer_orders
drawer_orders.description: Persistent orders and deadlines. List before updating an order. create requires id/title; update requires id. Dates use ISO 8601 with offset and timezone. A due change replaces the old reminder; reminder defaults to due unless explicitly provided, empty clears. done/cancelled suppress reminders. Stable create ids prevent duplicate retries. Results include delivery attempts/error state.

notes.description: Brief, scope, price and agreed details as supplied

due.description: Deadline ISO 8601 with zone offset; empty clears

remind_at.description: Reminder ISO timestamp with offset; empty disables

drawer_references.name: drawer_references
drawer_references.description: Persistent references linked to orders. save imports exact image bytes into SQLite from file (Telegram attachment cache or generation result) OR image_url (direct HTTP/S image); PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF up to 20 MiB. New save requires id/title and an image or source url. url alone stores only a link, never image bytes. Omitted metadata and existing binary are preserved on update. storage=blob confirms durable binary storage; link_only does not. list returns metadata, optional order_id filter. get(id) restores an image from SQLite and returns file plus MEDIA marker for sending or explicitly requested generation. No Base64 in responses.

url.description: Optional source HTTP(S) page URL; provenance only, not downloaded. Can be omitted for file. Defaults to image_url when supplied.

order_id.description: Existing order id, or empty for general reference

notes.description: Why this reference helps: pose, palette, lighting, etc.

file.description: Absolute local image path from the received Telegram attachment or selected generation. save copies actual bytes into SQLite before confirming success. Mutually exclusive with image_url.

image_url.description: Direct HTTP(S) image URL to download and store as binary, not a page. Mutually exclusive with file. Never use Telegram token-bearing API URLs; use the cached attachment path.

drawer_zimage.name: drawer_zimage
drawer_zimage.description: Z-Image Turbo W4A8 with abliterated Qwen only. GPU-only ComfyUI text-to-image, 1024x1024, one image. start with stable id and prompt; poll status with same tool/id. Return MEDIA marker and generation_seconds. Never resubmit uncertain submitting jobs. No editing.

drawer_qwen_image_3.name: drawer_qwen_image_3
drawer_qwen_image_3.description: Alibaba qwen-image-3.0 only: paid text-to-image and editing from up to 3 reference images. One output per request. start then status with SAME tool/id; no provider fallback. SUCCEEDED returns local media and execution seconds excluding queue/download. Include MEDIA marker in reply. submitting after error means unknown acceptance; never resubmit. Requires profile DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.

action.description: Submit once, or poll the same id until SUCCEEDED.

id.description: Stable id, 1-64 letters/digits/_/-. Never change id to retry an uncertain POST.

prompt.description: Positive prompt/edit instruction, 1-4000 characters. Refer to image 1, image 2 in input order.

images.description: Optional references: up to 3 public HTTPS URLs or absolute local PNG/JPEG/WebP paths, one per line. Local images max 10 MiB; sent to Alibaba as Base64. Use only user-selected images.

size.description: width*height, default 1024*1024. Pixel area 512²-2048², aspect ratio 1:8 to 8:1.

prompt_extend.description: Default false: no automatic prompt rewriting. true enables provider enhancement/thinking.

negative_prompt.description: Optional separate negative prompt, max 4000 characters. Empty by default; do not invent a stock list of prohibitions.

drawer_anima.name: drawer_anima
drawer_anima.description: Nova Anime AM v2.0 (Anima) with Qwen3 0.6B Base only. GPU-only ComfyUI text-to-image, 512x512, one image, 25 steps, CFG 5. Automatically prepends the user's quality/scenery prefix once and applies their fixed negative; pass only the scene prompt, without Prompt: labels. Read plugins/drawer/ANIMA.md for the exact preset and prompting instructions. Preserve supplied scene wording. For composing new prompts, use lowercase space-separated tags plus 2+ English sentences; describe each character separately. start with stable id and prompt; poll status with same tool/id. Return MEDIA marker and generation_seconds. Never resubmit uncertain submitting jobs. Reference images and editing are not supported by this tool.
